editorial.blurb: This authentic Korean jokbal specialist delivers Seoul-level comfort food with remarkable speed and genuine warmth in Glenview.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the jokbal in both spicy and original to experience the range—food arrives in ~5 minutes, and the generous portions feed many; plan to share and refill the addictive white kimchi banchan multiple times.

topDishes.note: Tender, juicy, chewy with ideal savory-sweet balance—reviewers call it the best in Chicago
Rich, savory broth with pork that melts off the bone, perfectly balanced and comforting
Exceptional banchan that diners refill multiple times, pairs beautifully with meat wraps
